biggest_catch: Limited-time window - new member accounts must be opened by October 31, 2026 - and your $50 doesn't land until 90 days after the account opens.
catches: Limited-time promotion: new member accounts must be opened before October 31, 2026; promotion subject to end at any time.
The new member must mention your name and the code 'SHARE' during account opening.
The $50 deposit is made to the referrer's base share 90 days after account opening, with a qualified loan or deposit opened and in good standing.
Promotional deposit cap is $600 per person (12 referrals).
Eligible persons are those who live, work, worship, volunteer, attend school or have businesses in Prince George's County, Maryland (plus eligible family); estate and minor accounts excluded.
Certain restrictions apply; contact the credit union for details.

steps: Share Prince George's Community FCU membership with a friend or family member eligible for membership.
Your referral opens an account online or at a branch before October 31, 2026, mentioning your name and the code 'SHARE'.
The new member opens a qualified loan or deposit and keeps the account in good standing.
You receive a $50 deposit into your base share 90 days after account opening - up to $600 per person.
